column1: # MECHANISM, three distinct false-positive shapes, all from grepping the WHOLE BODY:
#  (1) GPLv3 closing paragraph recommends the LGPL ............... GPL-3.0 -> LGPL   (p450, known)
#  (2) GPL-2.0 PREAMBLE line 18 names the Library/Lesser GPL ...... GPL-2.0 -> LGPL   (p487, NEW)
#      i-educar line 18: "the GNU Lesser General Public License instead.)" and again at line 338.
#      rosariosis line 18 carries the ORIGINAL 1991 wording "GNU Library General Public License",
#      which is why the same rule grades rosariosis correctly and i-educar wrongly. The variable is
#      the FSF's own post-1999 revision of the GPL-2.0 preamble, not anything either project did.
#  (3) GPL-3.0 section 13 is titled "Use with the GNU Affero GPL" .. GPL-3.0 -> AGPL  (p487, NEW)
#      lumen lines 552/556/559. This is the expensive one: it manufactures a network-copyleft verdict.
# THE SHELVES WERE RIGHT. i-educar is published here as GPL-2.0 and lumen as GPL-3.0, both correct.
# What is wrong is the RULE, which no gate has ever run against the payloads the shelves carry.
